topics.title: Hypnotic Intern Departure
topics.summary: During a radio segment focused on an intern’s farewell, hosts engage in increasingly suggestive conversations and attempt to hypnotize him into revealing uncomfortable details about his experiences. The discussion quickly escalates with explicit descriptions of physical interactions and confessions regarding unwanted advances.

topics.title: Hypnotic Claims and Celebrity Marriage Revelation
topics.summary: During the broadcast, hosts discuss a murder case involving Annette Green and Julia, then reveal an unexpected marriage between Rick O’Kessick of The Cars and supermodel Paulina Popescu – mirroring one of the host's dreams. They also address listener ratings and engagement, focusing on maintaining high numbers amidst discussions about marijuana use.

topics.title: Dream Predictions and Racial Tensions
topics.summary: Howard discusses bizarre dream predictions including George Burns’ death and a young girl's AIDS diagnosis. He then pivots to discussing racial tensions in Detroit, blaming Mayor Koch, while expressing interest in making a film like Spike Lee’s, recalling the ‘Orgasm Lady.’

topics.title: Awkward Discussion of Sexuality
topics.summary: A phone-in segment centers on a caller’s discomfort with the repeated use of ‘orgasm,’ triggered by her letter and escalating into an uncomfortable conversation regarding sexuality, parental concerns about children's access to adult material, and increasingly explicit suggestions involving physical acts. The discussion includes references to pornography.

topics.title: Stern Discusses FCC Scrutiny & Imitators
topics.summary: Howard Stern discusses listener reactions to his show’s content regarding the word ‘orgasm,’ leading to scrutiny from the Federal Communications Commission (FCC). He explains that this has prompted investigations into imitator radio shows and concerns about government regulation of speech, referencing a Bucks County Courier Times article.

topics.title: Len Bias Psychic Session & Rock Block
topics.summary: During a broadcast, Robin Quivers attempts a psychic connection with the recently deceased Len Bias, discussing his life and death while exploring cocaine use.
